Aventon Soltera 3 ADV
Lightweight Urban Ebike

 

The Aventon Soltera 3 ADV is built for riders who want a clean, low-maintenance daily ride. At 37 lbs it's the lightest ebike in the Aventon lineup, and the Gates Carbon Belt Drive system is the reason why - no chain, no derailleur, no cassette. Belt drives last 2-3 times as long as traditional drivetrains, don't stretch, don't need lubrication, and run quietly. A 250W hub motor with 40Nm of torque and a 366.8Wh integrated battery deliver up to 70 miles of range on the Aventon BC147 display. Integrated turn signals and front and rear lights are built in throughout, Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors handle stopping, and a double-sided bottom bracket torque sensor keeps the power delivery smooth and natural. Available by special order at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL in four sizes.

The Soltera 3 ADV ships as Class 1 and is not throttle compatible. IPX6 water resistance protects against heavy rain and puddles. Note: this is a single-speed bike - there are no gears to shift.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Soltera 3 ADV is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email contact@questwatersports.com.

Sizing:

  • Small - 5'1" to 5'5"
  • Medium - 5'5" to 5'9"
  • Large - 5'9" to 6'1"
  • Extra Large - 6'1" to 6'4"
 

Included with every Soltera 3 ADV:

  • Kickstand (in accessory box)
  • Integrated front and rear lights with turn signals
  • 9/16" composite platform pedals
  • 42V 4A charger

Drivetrain Single Speed - Gates Carbon Belt Drive - 60T Chainring / 22T Hub Flywheel
